pr.body:
Clean extraction of the 0001 DCP Routing Domain Model (design-only) from the mixed PR #854.

See:
- task-packets/DMX-DCP-MODEL-ROUTING-MVP-0001.md (authoritative contract, allowed/forbidden, hard stops)
- docs/03-reference/dcp/model-routing-domain.md
- The 9 dcp_routing_*.schema.json + test + 15 fixtures
- proof/DMX-DCP-MODEL-ROUTING-MVP-0001/ (fresh capture in dedicated worktree; explicit manual independent audit COMPLETE vs. embedded SKIPPED)

This PR contains **only** the 0001 domain model slice + the minimal .gitignore hygiene to make proof/ directories trackable for staged-diff gates.

Per AGENTS.md §8 and the embedded PROOF.json: merge_readiness BLOCKED_NOT_REQUESTED until PR Steward confirms on latest head after final capture.

Predecessor 0000* packets, OpenCode/PAL wiring (including the stdio proxy stub), Docker/compose changes, litellm security work, and other infra remain on the 854 lineage (or a follow-on B PR) and require their own runtime proofs + security classification before any merge consideration.

🤖 Carved per approved plan (see session plan.md) following AGENTS.md Codex lifecycle.
